# dist – release assets

This folder tracks packaged plugin builds for convenience.

**Download the latest stable ZIP from GitHub Releases:**

- https://github.com/mystasarim/bdi-pro-enhanced/releases (Assets section)
- Direct asset pattern: `https://github.com/mystasarim/bdi-pro-enhanced/releases/download/<TAG>/bdi-pro-enhanced-vX.zip`

> Tip: Upload the same ZIP here if you want to keep a copy in the repo. (Large binaries are not ideal for Git, but acceptable for convenience.)

## Install (WP-CLI)
```bash
wp plugin install "https://github.com/mystasarim/bdi-pro-enhanced/releases/download/v5.6.1-stable/bdi-pro-enhanced-v2.zip" --force --activate
```
